content: As social media continues to evolve, TikTok's algorithm prioritizes content that encourages user participation, such as interactive missions and collaborative unlocks. This shift in focus highlights the importance of immersive in-app experiences in engaging users and promoting brand partnerships. By leveraging these platform-specific strategies, marketers can tap into the vast potential of TikTok's user base, leading to increased brand awareness and loyalty. #TikTokMarketing #DigitalStrategy #InteractiveContent
